# Vendor Info: Ace Editor

- **Project**: [Ajax.org Cloud9 Editor](https://github.com/ajaxorg/ace)
- **Version**: 1.44.0
- **License**: BSD-3-Clause
- **Distribution**: [jsDelivr npm registry](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package/npm/ace-builds)

**How to update**
1. Open the central `vendor/updater.html` tool in your browser.
2. Select **Ace Editor** from the dropdown menu.
3. Click "Download" and select this local directory (`vendor/ace-editor/`) when prompted.
4. The tool will automatically update this `_VENDOR-INFO.md` file.
5. Update the version number in the root [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](../../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and [README.md](../../README.md).
